notes.title: Leaderboards & more
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, time for a new update!
Luciform's last update added new difficulty options, now it's time to keep score, and what better way to do it than an online leaderboard? 

from now - to make the playing ground fair, the leaderboards are split into 2.
One leaderboard for the Intended difficulty option, and one for the easy mode.
this system works automatically, if you play the random and endless mode with the intended difficulty on, you will automatically submit the score into the correct leaderboard, and vice-versa.

Some more changes to the game
- Early levels got easier to make sure the learning curve of the gameplay is easier.
- A huge FPS boost for low-end machines.
- Small issues with the colorblind modes fixed.
- Boss AI improved.
- Fixed tutorial minor bugs (for example getting stuck in a platform)

Oh! and the game is now 20% off! 
So if you haven't grabbed it yet - now it's the time to join in.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1239980/Luciform/

notes.title: New difficulty options!
notes.notes:
Now you can choose between easy/hard difficulty to play Luciform!
Please note that the game was designed to play on the harder difficulty, so please give it a try before switching to the easier option.

When playing the hard difficulty -
Luci can never slow down and can change directions mid-air

When playing the easy difficulty -
Luci is waiting in place and can change direction without jumping
